feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 13 September 2026 5:26pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 13 September 2026 at 4:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Weak ridge over Britain, soon declining followed by frontal troughs from the southwest.


##Wind##

Variable 2 to 4, settling south or southeast this evening, veering south or southwest 3 or 4 overnight, increasing 4 or 5 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair at first, patchy rain or drizzle overnight with areas of mist and isolated fog patches, becoming mainly fair tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, becoming moderate or poor overnight and occasionally very poor in fog patches.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, imminently increasing 5 or 6, veering west or southwest overnight into Tuesday, then decreasing 4 or 5.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, imminently becoming mainly moderate, perhaps occasionally rough in places, becoming slight or moderate on Tuesday morning.


##Weather##

Occasional rain as well as a risk of areas of mist and isolated fog patches, soon becoming mainly fair for Tuesday with only isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor or very poor at first. becoming mainly good.
